invariant: unscreened Bash or read output is never treated as Firstmate truth
why: it cannot withhold on Claude, so it reported itself as protection it did not provide; the note it appended was advisory only
replaced_by: nothing; the same invariant is carried by the human review of tool output and by jev-pretool-deny for actions, not reads

invariant: a write or edit Jev classifies as a secrets file never runs
why: the write kind Choice (assessment Q3) gated on a category label and its confidence; it never chose secrets in 4,363 judged writes, and the harm it named, a credential committed or shipped, happens at commit and push rather than at write

invariant: a write or edit whose content Jev scores as a real credential never runs
why: the contains_secret Noul (assessment Q4) never reached its 0.70 threshold in 4,363 judged writes (maximum 0.52), and writing a key into an ignored .env is correct behaviour; the harm is a key reaching a commit or a push

invariant: a write or edit too long for model screening never runs while its replacement text holds a known credential shape
why: the local shape check existed only to cover the unscreened remainder of the write-time size path; with no write-content model screening there is no remainder, and the same anchored shapes now run over added lines at commit and push

invariant: a write or edit whose required content judgment cannot run never runs
why: write-content review-on-unavailable denials (request too large, provider outage, never-send withholding) refused harmless writes such as a worker report, and a write no longer has a content judgment to require
replaced_by: git-commit-credential-shapes and git-push-credential-shapes in bin/fm-git-secrets.py; shell judgments keep jev-pretool-deny
